NOTE
**Still not ready — the question about the other open PR is still unanswered**

New: The author says the description now explains how this PR relates to the other open PRs, and that it has precise before/after screenshots. The description does show before/after images and a video. Missing: it never mentions #33086, an older open PR for the same issue that changes the same two files, and the author doesn't say why this PR is needed instead.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to explain, in the description, how this PR differs from #33086, following the continuing-unfinished-work guide.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! I don't see anything in the PR description about #33086, which is an open PR for the same issue touching the same files. Could you add a short explanation of how this PR relates to it (and why you're not building on it), following the [continuing unfinished work guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html)?
```
